fr_html:
Au cours de la discussion, LORD PHILLIMORE
dit que dans l'exposé de ses points de
vue, qu'il va faire au Comité, il compte traiter
exclusivement de la question de la nomination
des juges.
en_html:
During the discussion LORD PHILLIMORE
said that in the explanation of his views, which he
would give to the Committee, he intended to
deal solely with the question of the nomination of
judges.
fr_text: Au cours de la discussion, LORD PHILLIMORE dit que dans l'exposé de ses points de vue, qu'il va faire au Comité, il compte traiter exclusivement de la question de la nomination des juges.
en_text: During the discussion LORD PHILLIMORE said that in the explanation of his views, which he would give to the Committee, he intended to deal solely with the question of the nomination of judges.
